daemonMessages.merge_sha_missing: {guard, select, code_self {Code-self guard: this task must merge its own branch. } other {}}Merge guard: DONE is rejected without merged_commit_sha — the branch was not merged (or the SHA was not recorded). Close with `timon task done <id> --merged-sha <SHA>` (40 hex; see `git rev-parse HEAD`), or include that full sha in your comment.
daemonMessages.merge_sha_abbreviated: {guard, select, code_self {Code-self guard: this task must merge its own branch. } other {}}Merge guard: DONE is rejected without merged_commit_sha — the branch was not merged (or the SHA was not recorded). Your comment contains {short}, which looks like an ABBREVIATED SHA: the guard accepts only the full form (40 hex). Resolve it with `git rev-parse {short}` then close with `timon task done <id> --merged-sha <SHA-40-hex>`.
daemonMessages.review_verdict_unparsable: Review verdict not parsable in done_comment (expected: JSON with "verdict": "pass" or "changes_requested"). done_comment received: {excerpt, select, none {(empty)} other {{excerpt}}}
daemonMessages.backend_cannot_read_attachments: Backend `{backend}` cannot read files on this host (no `attachments` capability), and this task has {count, plural, one {# attached file} other {# attached files}}. Assign the task to an agent on a local backend, set a local backend on the task (backend override), or remove the attachments.
daemonMessages.backend_cannot_use_worktree: Backend `{backend}` does not work in Timon's folder (no `worktree` capability), so a `{type}` task cannot run on it. Assign the task to an agent on a local backend, or set a local backend on the task (backend override) or on the project's role.
daemonMessages.task_extras_widen: An agent's mission wrote this task, and its extras would give agent "{agent}" more than it holds: {refusal}. Remove these extras from the task, or grant them to "{agent}" first, then retry the task.
daemonMessages.task_cwd_unusable: {cause, select, denied {Working directory access denied ({errno}): {path}} other {{cause, select, not_a_directory {Working directory is not a directory: {path}} other {Working directory not found: {path}}}}}. The mission was not started: restore this folder, or change the working directory of the agent or its project, then retry the task.
daemonMessages.task_spawn_failed: Spawn failed ({attempts}×): {error}. The mission never started — this is not a business block.{exhausted, plural, =0 {} other { Automatic retries are exhausted (# system deaths in a row): Timon will not replay this task on its own any more. Once the cause is dealt with, restart it by hand: move it back to Pending on the board, or run `timon task update {taskId} --status PENDING`.}}
daemonMessages.task_interrupted: Mission interrupted: {reason, select, rate_limit {account usage limit reached{window, select, none { (unknown window)} other { ({window})}}{reopens, select, none {, reopening time not reported by the backend} other {, quota reopens at {reopens}, the task restarts on its own after that}}} exhausted {account out of credit (HTTP 402) — nothing reopens on its own, it has to be topped up. The series fallback takes over} backend_unavailable {backend structurally unavailable — the CLI reported an authentication failure, or several missions returned instantly without producing a single turn (expired login, no credit left, dead endpoint). The series fallback takes over} overloaded {the provider reported the model at capacity (overloaded) — transient; the task moves to its fallback backend when one exists, otherwise it is replayed later} permission_denied {permission denied on a tool use (the CLI stops dead, the task is not closed out)} killed {process killed (manual stop or idle-mission reap)} stopped {turn stopped by hand from the chat (the conversation stays resumable)} timeout {turn silent too long — no output from the agent within the hung threshold (hung reap)} turn_budget {turn ran past its duration budget while still active (turn budget reap)} crash {unexpected stop of the process or of the orchestrator} other {undetermined cause — the process died without closing the task out and its stream yielded no usable signal}} — observed at {observed}. This is NOT a business block: the task was never closed out by the agent.{lastError, select, none {} other { Last error: {lastError}}}{context, select, spawn_refused { The turn was refused before spawn.} boot_orphan { Orphan reconciled at boot: the mission finished without transitioning the task.} other {}}{exhausted, plural, =0 {} other { Automatic retries are exhausted (# system deaths in a row): Timon will not replay this task on its own any more. Once the cause is dealt with, restart it by hand: move it back to Pending on the board, or run `timon task update {taskId} --status PENDING`.}}
daemonMessages.merge_held_no_verdict: Merge held: review {reviewId} is DONE but its done_comment carries NO usable verdict (expected a first line `verdict: pass` or `verdict: changes_requested`). Without an explicit verdict there is no merge. Have the review closed again with a verdict, or unblock it by hand after reading the diff.
daemonMessages.repair_wait_stalled: Review {reviewId} of code {codeId} requested changes, waiting for the repair iteration — no iteration has appeared in {waited} min (limit {limit} min). The verification loop did not create one (iteration cap reached, chain root gone, or a lost event). Create the repair iteration by hand, or re-run the review, then unblock this task.
daemonMessages.git_missing_for_task: git not found on this host: code, review and merge tasks of a git project need git. Install git, then restart Timon.
daemonMessages.integration_branch_unset: Integration mode "{mode}" needs an integration branch and the remote ref to cut it from (base "{branch}", remote ref "{baseRef}"). The task was not started: set both on the task, then retry it.
daemonMessages.integration_branch_unavailable: Integration branch {branch} is unavailable: {detail}. The task was not started, and the branch is never cut from the local base instead of {baseRef}. Fix the remote or the branch name, then retry the task.
daemonMessages.task_base_missing: Base {base} does not exist in the repository. The task was not started: a {type} task never runs without its base. Create the branch or change the task's base, then retry it.
daemonMessages.task_worktree_unavailable: No worktree for this {type} task ({cause}). It was not started: in the agent's own folder it would write to the checkout every agent shares. Fix the cause, then retry the task.

review_verdict_unusable.title: Review with no usable verdict: {title}

task_system_deaths.title: Task keeps failing ({deaths} system deaths): {title}
task_system_deaths.body:
Task `{taskId}` was interrupted by a system death ({reason}) after {requeues} automatic requeues. It stays BLOCKED: retrying once more would give the same result.{detail, select, none {} other {

{detail}}}

merge_audit_missing_sha.title: {count, plural, one {# merge task DONE with no merge sha} other {# merge tasks DONE with no merge sha}}

backend_signed_out.title: Backend {backend}: signed out — log in again
backend_signed_out.body:
The `{backend}` CLI reports an authentication failure (its session expired and could not be refreshed).

**Action needed:** sign in to the `{backend}` CLI again on this machine. Nothing retries it into working.

- Backend sidelined until {until, date, medium} {until, time, short}, or until a turn succeeds on it.
- Missions and tasks that depend on it switch onto their fallback plan.

backend_account_signed_out.title: {backend} account "{account}": signed out — sign in again
backend_account_signed_out.body:
The `{backend}` CLI reports an authentication failure on the account "{account}".

**Action needed:** sign this account in again. Until then its missions are refused; they never move to another subscription (an orchestrator piloting a series may move to another connection of its owner), and the other accounts keep running.

orchestrator_stranded.title: Orchestrator stopped: no usable fallback for {backend}

backend_breaker_tripped.title: Backend {backend}: sidelined by the circuit breaker

wake_backpressure_stalled.title: Wake loop blocked by back-pressure: {agent}
wake_backpressure_stalled.body:
Wake for agent `{agent}` has been deferred for {attempts, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} (~{minutes} min).
Reason: {reason}.

{waiting, plural, one {# message is waiting in its inbox and cannot be processed.} other {# messages are waiting in its inbox and cannot be processed.}}
Likely cause: global mission cap reached (paused/zombie mission?) or high machine load. Check the state of live missions.

wake_abandoned.title: Wake abandoned: {agent}
wake_abandoned.body:
{agent} could not be woken {ceiling} times in a row, so {expired, plural, one {# message addressed to it was} other {# messages addressed to it were}} set aside (status `expired`) instead of being retried.

Last error: {error}

blocking_loop_detected.title: Blocking loop detected; intervention required: {title}
blocking_loop_detected.body:
Task {taskId} (group {group, select, none {none} other {{group}}}) has been blocked {wakes} times in a row. The wake loop stopped waking the orchestrator to break the loop. Reason for the last blockage: {reason, select, none {(unspecified)} other {{reason}}}.

Unblock it manually after review (UI Kanban → task {taskId}).

resource_memory_max.title: Memory ceiling reached ({label})
resource_memory_max.body: Cgroup {unit} hit MemoryMax ({max}) {times, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}. No OOM kill so far, but there is no headroom left.

resource_memory_high.title: Memory pressure ({label})
resource_memory_high.body: Cgroup {unit} went over MemoryHigh ({high}) — usage {usage}. The kernel throttles and reclaims memory; nothing is killed, but the load is abnormal.

resource_oom_killed.title: OOM: {count, plural, one {# process} other {# processes}} killed in {label}
resource_oom_killed.body: The kernel killed {count, plural, one {# process} other {# processes}} of cgroup {unit} (memory {usage} / max {max}). A task may have failed without a readable message — check `journalctl -k -g "Out of memory"`.

resource_mission_killed.title: OOM: mission {mission} — process killed
resource_mission_killed.body: [Timon resource guard] {cmd, select, none {{pid, select, none {One of your processes} other {Your process pid {pid}}}} other {Your process `{cmd}`{pid, select, none {} other { (pid {pid})}}}} was killed by the kernel: it used {ceiling, select, none {too much memory} other {more than {ceiling} of memory}}, {whose, select, slice {the ceiling shared by all running missions} other {the ceiling of this mission}}.{rss, select, none {} other { It held {rss} when it was killed.}} Running the same command again will be killed the same way. Find the cause first — an infinite loop, a leak, an unbounded dataset — and run a narrower target (`npm test -- <file>`) once it is fixed.

resource_pressure_high.title: High memory pressure (missions)
resource_pressure_high.body: Missions spend {pressure} % of their time stalled waiting for memory (usage {usage} / max {max}). Above {limit} for 20 s, systemd-oomd will kill a mission.

merge_repair_by_hand.title: Merge to repair by hand: {title}

chain_abandoned.title: Chain abandoned: {title}
chain_abandoned.body:
The follow-up chain of task {taskId} ({type}, "{title}") failed {attempts} times in a row: its review / merge / doc were not created and will no longer be created automatically.

A failure that repeats this often is structural (worktree cleaned up, project role that cannot be resolved, error in a step of the chain) — the `[task-chain]` logs of this task carry the cause.

To replay: dispatching the task again resets the counter.

sandbox_cascade_ahead.title: {type} will run on `{target}`, whose sandbox just failed: {title}

ask_user_form_looping.title: Agent form looping: {agent}
ask_user_form_looping.body: {attempts} invalid form payloads in a row on mission {mission} — last defect: {defect}. No card could be created, so you saw nothing go by. The form channel is closed for this mission: the agent was instructed to decide for itself while stating its assumption, or to close out via `timon task block`. The decision it wanted to submit to you is still pending.

late_answer_not_replayed.title: Late answer could not be replayed: {tool}
late_answer_not_replayed.body: You answered `{tool}` for mission {mission} but it could not be relaunched (process dead, no resumable session). {taskId, select, none {Relaunch the mission if the action is still needed.} other {Associated task: {taskId} ({taskTitle}). Relaunch it if needed.}}

agent_pair_loop_stopped.title: Agent loop stopped: {a} ↔ {b}
agent_pair_loop_stopped.body:
`{a}` and `{b}` exchanged {count} messages within {minutes} min with no human input. Their messages are now held in the inbox (status "held") and neither agent wakes the other any more.

Write to either agent in the chat to resume them. Held messages are not redelivered. Ceiling: TIMON_WAKE_PAIR_MAX_MESSAGES ({max}), window: TIMON_WAKE_PAIR_WINDOW_MS.

memory_proposals_to_review.title: Memory {slug}: {count, plural, one {# recurring fact} other {# recurring facts}} to review
memory_proposals_to_review.body:
These facts recur ≥{threshold}× and are proposed for promotion (proposals.md of project `{slug}`). Approve them by copying them into the suggested curated file through the project memory UI/API.

{top}

deploy_rebuild_failed.title: Automatic rebuild failed: {service}

deploy_rebuilt.title: Automatic deploy: `{service}` rebuilt ✅
deploy_rebuilt.body: Merge {sha} ("{title}") changed `{service}/` → container rebuilt and restarted automatically. The change is live.

orchestrator_restart_required.title: Orchestrator restart required

shell_preallow_inert.title: Shell pre-allow ignored in auto mode: {agent}
shell_preallow_inert.body:
{agent} pre-allows {rules} but runs in auto mode: the claude CLI ignores a rule that allows every shell command there, and a command its classifier cannot judge waits for an approval (an autonomous mission is denied after the delay). To keep the rule, run the agent in acceptEdits, and its project role too if it sets one; or pre-allow narrower patterns such as Bash(git:*).

Auto mode was set by {source, select, mission {its task or project role} other {its own config}}.

shell_preallow_rerouted.title: Shell pre-allow not used: {named}
shell_preallow_rerouted.body: Task {task} names {named}, which pre-allows {rules}, but runs on {routed}, which does not ({why}). Its shell commands go to the classifier, and one it cannot judge waits for an approval. Give {routed} the same allowed tools, or let the task run on {named}.

backend_no_credit.title: Backend {backend}: no credit left
backend_no_credit.body:
`{backend}` answers with a payment error (HTTP 402 / balance exhausted): the account has no credit left.

Unlike a usage limit, **this does not reopen on its own** — the account has to be topped up.

- Backend sidelined until {until, date, medium} {until, time, short} (or until a turn succeeds on it again).
- Missions and tasks that depend on it switch onto their fallback plan.

series_fallback_applied.title: {outcome, select, rule {Fallback rule applied — series moved (scope {scope})} switched {Quota exhausted — series switched to its fallback plan} stuck {Quota exhausted — tasks switched, orchestrator NOT moved} other {Quota exhausted — tasks switched to their fallback plan}}

integration_gave_up.title: A messaging integration stopped retrying a message
integration_gave_up.body: A message on the {transport} connection could not be processed. Replay it from {settingsPath}.

plugin_spawn_quota.body: {count} missions in {minutes} min{extra, plural, =0 {} other {, and `{via}` asked for # more}}. Raise `pluginPolicy.spawn.max` if this is expected.

backend_launch_unauthorized.title: Backend `{backend}` was not started: its program needs your authorization
backend_launch_unauthorized.body: {reason} Open this card to review the program on the provider’s page ({settingsPath}) and authorize it again if it is the one you expect.

plugin_secret_global_lost.title: Plugin `{pluginId}` no longer reads the secret `{name}`
plugin_secret_global_lost.body: `{name}` is shared with every agent (`global`), which no longer reaches plugins. If you trust this plugin with it, grant it by name: open this card (Secrets page, Grant) or run `timon secret grant {name} --scope {scope}`.

backend_key_shared.title: The key of backend `{backend}` is still shared outside it
backend_key_shared.body: `{name}` was created for backend `{backend}` and is now granted to {scopes}: it still enters those missions whatever backend they run on. To keep it on this backend only, for the same missions: `timon secret grant {name} --scope backend:{backend}`. To keep sharing it as it is, change its note in the Secrets page: it is then yours, and no longer removed with the backend.

plugin_async_failure.title: Plugin {pluginId}: an asynchronous operation failed
plugin_async_failure.body: Timon kept running. The plugin left an error unhandled; the daemon log has the details. Update or disable the plugin if it repeats.

triggers_check_after_rename.title: {count, plural, one {Check a trigger} other {Check # triggers}}: agent {oldName} is now {newName}

The filter of these event triggers matches the agent’s name by pattern or substring and no longer reads it the same way. They were left unchanged: review each one on the Triggers page.
{list}

main_seat_empty.title: No main orchestrator
main_seat_empty.body: No agent holds the main orchestrator seat: recaps and notifications have no recipient. {candidates, select, none {No project-less orchestrator exists. Create one in **Agents**: when it is the only one, it takes the seat by itself.} other {Eligible orchestrators: {candidates}. In **Agents**, open the one you talk to and choose **Set as main orchestrator**, or run `timon agent set-main <name>`.}}

license_off.title: Licence is no longer valid
